name: code-style-md
description: How Markdown is written in every repository: one paragraph per line, never wrapped by hand and with no forced breaks, kept by Prettier with proseWrap never; code spans for everything literal and bold kept rare; fenced code blocks with their language and commands without a prompt; relative links inside the repo; small tables for comparisons only; sentence-case headings, alerts, Mermaid diagrams, and HTML only where Markdown cannot; and the one-off sweep that brings an existing repo in line.
